title: Set-based State Estimation for Unknown Dynamical Systems from Noisy Output Data with Probabilistic Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2611.19716v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a methodology for set-based state estimation from noisy input-output trajectories, without a predefined model structure for the unknown state dynamics or access to training state measurements. We derive a bound on the state set diameter that depends on the sensor map and leverage it as a surrogate to formulate a tractable linear program balancing state set tightness against output trajectory coverage. Combining this certificate with deterministic or probabilistically certified measurement noise sets and leveraging the results from scenario optimization with relaxation, we provide joint a posteriori probabilistic guarantees for state inclusion and state set diameter. Numerical simulations corroborate our developed theoretical guarantees.

translated_title: 基于集合的未知动态系统状态估计：从含噪声输出数据中获得概率保证
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种基于集合的状态估计方法，可从含噪声的输入-输出轨迹中进行估计，而无需预先定义未知状态动态的模型结构，也无需访问训练用的状态测量数据。我们推导了一个依赖于传感器映射的状态集合直径上界，并将其作为替代量构建一个可求解的线性规划，以平衡状态集合的紧凑性与输出轨迹的覆盖性。将该证书与确定性或经概率认证的测量噪声集合相结合，并利用带松弛的场景优化理论结果，我们为状态包含性和状态集合直径提供了联合的后验概率保证。数值仿真验证了我们提出的理论保证。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需模型结构和状态测量数据的集合式状态估计方法，通过线性规划平衡状态集合紧凑性与轨迹覆盖性，并借助场景优化为状态包含性和集合直径提供联合后验概率保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a set-based state estimation method that requires neither model structure nor state measurements, formulating a tractable linear program that balances state set tightness against output trajectory coverage, while providing joint a posteriori probabilistic guarantees for state inclusion and set diameter via relaxed scenario optimization.
